versions.changelog:
- Added a new section explaining how to redeploy (rebuild) an existing app instance after pushing new commits, without needing to send configuration again.
- Clarified that listing agents can be used to find the app instance id if it is unknown.
- Provided updated workflow for quickly shipping a new version, emphasizing only the API key and instance id are needed.
- Original step "Change something and rebuild" has been moved and now follows the new section on redeploying, differentiated as configuration changes vs. simple rebuilds.
- No code or functionality changes; documentation improvement only.

Initial release of deploy-app: a skill for deploying fullstack apps from git repositories to AgentsPodium.

- Deploy frontend and backend (monorepo or single repo) on one pod behind a single domain with TLS.
- Supports static sites and servers (Node, Python, Go, Docker; Node & static proven).
- Persistent disk survives rebuilds; no function-splitting or per-service billing.
- Built-in support for private repositories via encrypted repo tokens.
- Includes customizable build and start commands, environment variables, and domain handling.
- Webhook and build-level status monitoring available.
